study_note: TD-AMBI prior reward autotemp objective-family variant. The outer temperature is learned from initial alpha 1e-4 toward explicit scaled-entropy target -441; Q normalization is disabled. Reward-only critics bootstrap with Q and no entropy bonus. Actors use literal TD-MPC2 scaled entropy, smooth tanh log-standard-deviation mapping over [-10, 2], and mean-pair Q; critics use min-pair targets and distributional cross-entropy coefficient 0.1. Collection samples the stochastic outer policy after standard random warmup, with mpc=false and inner_operator=none. Inner compute counts are zero and inactive inner-only settings are neutralized without changing outer learning. All step checkpoints and adjacent metadata are retained every 25,000 decisions. All variants retain Humanoid Walk state observations, seed 55, 2 million decisions, outer batch 256, UTD=1, H=3, rho=0.5, model-size 5, and the other TD-AMBI backbone settings. Controller evaluation, paired controller evaluation, real-environment value evaluation, value-equivalence diagnostics/loss, and imagined diagnostics are disabled. This is a single-seed exploratory comparison, not confirmatory evidence. Each completed run produces 80 scheduled checkpoints.
